correctness.rationale: Conditional martingale FCLT and LLT apply to the admitted ERW. Nonzero moving-boundary hitting follows from nearest-neighbor crossing, FCLT and atomlessness of minima of Brownian motion plus C1 drift. Late hitting is uniformly small by Gaussian small-window plus L2 martingale bounds; Azuma and LLT permit global Riemann summation. Brownian swept intervals give the exact constant, and almost-sure unique Brownian argmax plus arcsine law gives the derivative. The bundled exact finite-state and seeded numerical checker passed, but is not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full text of Trinas 2611.01279v1, especially Corollary 8.2 and Section 10, ends at target radius o(sqrt n), explicitly proposing critical sqrt n targets as further work. The present claim proves the fixed-radius critical profile C_a(c), its swept Brownian interval representation and first derivative. The closest indexed critical-memory elephant result concerns p=3/4, not fixed p>3/4. A general boundary-crossing theorem could possibly offer an implicit derivation; this remains a priority risk.
